paragraphs.source_en: Hideyasu, who had been notified in advance, was resting in a large pavilion bearing the paulownia crest, erected on a hill about two chō away. He was no longer a member of the Tokugawa family, but Hashiba Mikawa-no-kami Hideyasu.

units.source_en: Hideyasu, who had been notified in advance, was resting in a large pavilion bearing the paulownia crest, erected on a hill about two chō away.
units.source_zh: 已先打过招呼的秀康，在距此地二町左右的山丘上，让人搭好了桐纹的大帐，正在里面歇息。

units.source_en: He was no longer a member of the Tokugawa family, but Hashiba Mikawa-no-kami Hideyasu.
units.source_zh: 他已经不是德川家的人，而是羽柴三河守秀康了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 已先打过招呼的秀康，在距此地二町左右的山丘上，让人搭好了桐纹的大帐，正在里面歇息。他已经不是德川家的人，而是羽柴三河守秀康了。

paragraphs.source_en: Kazumasa headed straight for the pavilion, but then suddenly stopped. To his right, a narrow winding path threaded through a lush green grove of cherry trees. He found himself taking that path without conscious thought, perhaps because his mind was unsettled and he dreaded facing Ogimaru, Katsuchiyo, Senchiyo, and the others.

units.source_en: Kazumasa headed straight for the pavilion, but then suddenly stopped.
units.source_zh: 数正直接朝那大帐走去，却又突然收住了脚步。

units.source_en: To his right, a narrow winding path threaded through a lush green grove of cherry trees.
units.source_zh: 樱树丛夹着右边的一条羊肠小道，绿意盎然。

units.source_en: He found himself taking that path without conscious thought, perhaps because his mind was unsettled and he dreaded facing Ogimaru, Katsuchiyo, Senchiyo, and the others.

ja.t: かったからかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 他在无意之中走上了这条路，可能是因为心神不定，他怕见于义丸、胜千代和仙千代他们。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正直接朝那大帐走去，却又突然收住了脚步。樱树丛夹着右边的一条羊肠小道，绿意盎然。他在无意之中走上了这条路，可能是因为心神不定，他怕见于义丸、胜千代和仙千代他们。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly Kazumasa noticed the sunlight filtering through the trees and dappling the ground, while countless ants streamed ceaselessly in and out of a hole beneath a tree stump. He trod on the swarm, but at once realized how cruel he was being. Regretfully he looked away, but when he turned back again, he saw the tiny red ants marching onward as though nothing had happened.

units.source_en: Suddenly Kazumasa noticed the sunlight filtering through the trees and dappling the ground, while countless ants streamed ceaselessly in and out of a hole beneath a tree stump.
units.source_zh: 数正突然看到阳光透过树隙斑斑点点地照在地上，无数的蚂蚁连续不断地在树桩下的洞穴进进出出。

units.source_en: He trod on the swarm, but at once realized how cruel he was being.
units.source_zh: 他用脚踏着那群蚂蚁，但立即意识到自己太残忍。

units.source_en: Regretfully he looked away, but when he turned back again, he saw the tiny red ants marching onward as though nothing had happened.

ja.t: もなかったかのように

units.source_zh: 他后悔地把视线转向别处，但再次去看那些蚂蚁时，却发现那些小小的红蚁就像什么都没发生过，继续前进着。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正突然看到阳光透过树隙斑斑点点地照在地上，无数的蚂蚁连续不断地在树桩下的洞穴进进出出。他用脚踏着那群蚂蚁，但立即意识到自己太残忍。他后悔地把视线转向别处，但再次去看那些蚂蚁时，却发现那些小小的红蚁就像什么都没发生过，继续前进着。

paragraphs.source_en: Kazumasa stared at the ants in astonishment. A new understanding came to him, though he could not clearly put it into words. He felt that the tenacity displayed by each of those ants was closer to his own nature than either Hideyoshi or Ieyasu was. Seeing the column of ants restore itself even after being trampled several times, he sprang excitedly to his feet. At that moment, a golden light suddenly flashed in the depths of his heart and swept away the clouds of confusion.

units.source_en: Kazumasa stared at the ants in astonishment. A new understanding came to him, though he could not clearly put it into words.

ja.t: まれたが、それをうまく
にすることはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 数正吃惊地看着蚁群，有了新的感悟，却无法用语言清楚地表达。

units.source_en: He felt that the tenacity displayed by each of those ants was closer to his own nature than either Hideyoshi or Ieyasu was.
units.source_zh: 他觉得那一只只蚂蚁坚韧的举动，比秀吉和家康更接近自己。

units.source_en: Seeing the column of ants restore itself even after being trampled several times, he sprang excitedly to his feet. At that moment, a golden light suddenly flashed in the depths of his heart and swept away the clouds of confusion.
units.source_zh: 看到那几度被踩的蚁阵竟又恢复了原样，他兴奋地站起身，此时，他内心深处突然闪出一道金光，拨开了迷惑的云雾。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正吃惊地看着蚁群，有了新的感悟，却无法用语言清楚地表达。他觉得那一只只蚂蚁坚韧的举动，比秀吉和家康更接近自己。看到那几度被踩的蚁阵竟又恢复了原样，他兴奋地站起身，此时，他内心深处突然闪出一道金光，拨开了迷惑的云雾。

paragraphs.source_en: “What if I belong to neither side?”

units.source_en: “What if I belong to neither side?”
units.source_zh: “若我不属于任何一方呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: Had Ogimaru not already become Hideyoshi’s son? And was the man inside the paulownia-crested curtains not Hashiba Mikawa-no-kami Hideyasu?

units.source_en: Had Ogimaru not already become Hideyoshi’s son?
units.source_zh: 于义丸不已经是秀吉的孩子了吗？

units.source_en: And was the man inside the paulownia-crested curtains not Hashiba Mikawa-no-kami Hideyasu?
units.source_zh: 桐纹幔幕里的，不是羽柴三河守秀康吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 于义丸不已经是秀吉的孩子了吗？桐纹幔幕里的，不是羽柴三河守秀康吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Kazumasa stretched, smiled, and strode away with a buoyant heart. He could see the way clearly now, and his heart grew lighter with every step. The two men hemming him in were no longer immovable boulders—today, without even intending it, I proved capable of standing alone against Hideyoshi; now I need only use the same attitude and methods to change Ieyasu as well. I have only one purpose: to prevent the two sides from coming into conflict.

units.source_en: Kazumasa stretched, smiled, and strode away with a buoyant heart.
units.source_zh: 数正伸了个懒腰，微笑着，畅快而去。

units.source_en: He could see the way clearly now, and his heart grew lighter with every step.
units.source_zh: 他已经看清楚了，心情越来越轻松。

units.source_en: The two men hemming him in were no longer immovable boulders—today, without even intending it, I proved capable of standing alone against Hideyoshi; now I need only use the same attitude and methods to change Ieyasu as well.
units.source_zh: 夹着他的两人，已不是什么巨石——我今日无意之中有能力独自抵挡秀吉，如也用相同的态度和方法去改变家康就好了。

units.source_en: I have only one purpose: to prevent the two sides from coming into conflict.
units.source_zh: 我的目的只有一个，就是使双方不发生冲突。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正伸了个懒腰，微笑着，畅快而去。他已经看清楚了，心情越来越轻松。夹着他的两人，已不是什么巨石——我今日无意之中有能力独自抵挡秀吉，如也用相同的态度和方法去改变家康就好了。我的目的只有一个，就是使双方不发生冲突。

paragraphs.source_en: When Kazumasa entered the pavilion, Senchiyo, the son of Honda Sakuza, asked, “Has it been decided when the young lord will take the field for the first time?”

units.source_en: When Kazumasa entered the pavilion, Senchiyo, the son of Honda Sakuza, asked, “Has it been decided when the young lord will take the field for the first time?”
units.source_zh: 数正进入大帐时，本多作左的儿子仙千代问道：“公子初征的事定了吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正进入大帐时，本多作左的儿子仙千代问道：“公子初征的事定了吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “His first campaign?” Kazumasa sat down on the camp stool and smiled knowingly.

units.source_en: “His first campaign?”
units.source_zh: “初征？”

units.source_en: Kazumasa sat down on the camp stool and smiled knowingly.
units.source_zh: 数正在床几上坐了下来，意味深长地笑了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “初征？”数正在床几上坐了下来，意味深长地笑了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Well, has it been decided, old man?” Hideyasu asked impatiently as well.

units.source_en: “Well, has it been decided, old man?”
units.source_zh: “定了吗，老人家？”

units.source_en: Hideyasu asked impatiently as well.
units.source_zh: 秀康也着急地问道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “定了吗，老人家？”秀康也着急地问道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha ha ha! Don’t be impatient. From now on, war will no longer be merely a matter of destroying one’s enemies. Only by finding ways to make the greatest possible use of them can one achieve complete victory!” With that, Kazumasa laughed merrily.

units.source_en: “Ha ha ha! Don’t be impatient. From now on, war will no longer be merely a matter of destroying one’s enemies. Only by finding ways to make the greatest possible use of them can one achieve complete victory!”

ja.t: ぼすだけのものではない。

units.source_zh: “哈哈哈，别着急，以后的战争，已经不仅是消灭敌人了，而是要想办法多多利用敌人，才能取得彻底的胜利！”

units.source_en: With that, Kazumasa laughed merrily.
units.source_zh: 说罢，数正乐呵呵地笑了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哈哈哈，别着急，以后的战争，已经不仅是消灭敌人了，而是要想办法多多利用敌人，才能取得彻底的胜利！”说罢，数正乐呵呵地笑了。
